identity.name: Black Bay
identity.one_liner: The standard 41mm Black Bay diver, moved to Tudor's in-house MT5602 chronometer movement in 2016 while keeping the domed crystal, snowflake hands, and riveted-look bracelet of the earlier ETA-powered version.

comps.condition: 79230N Heritage Black Bay, full set, no-reserve

provenance_events.description: Tudor releases the 79230N Black Bay 41mm as the standard 41mm Black Bay. The reference is a particular favourite of the Asian ADs, with Hong Kong, Singapore, and Tokyo boutiques running steady demand through the late 2010s.

narrative.story: The original 2012 Black Bay ran a modified ETA 2824 movement under reference 79220. In 2016 Tudor replaced it with the in-house MT5602 and renumbered the black-dial version 79230N, keeping the same case, bezel, and oversized winding crown that made the original Black Bay a breakout success.
narrative.collector_notes: Buyers should confirm whether a listing is the earlier ETA-based 79220 or the in-house 79230N before comparing price, since the two look nearly identical from the dial side but differ in movement, power reserve, and caseback.
